structured_output.what_is_happening: "gascoin" ($gas) launched on pump.fun at about 00:00 UTC through the UsePaid launcher. The creator address is a platform launcher with more than 166k tokens. Fees go to X user @deobfuscations and the coin links to an X status (i/status/2103635515056824398) that I could not read. It left the bonding curve in about 2.5 minutes. About 10 minutes after the pair opened it was at $289k market cap, with $436k volume, about 1,700 unique buyers and a +487% move. Its price was still about 30% below its all-time high. At least 5 more "gascoin" copies launched within minutes of it. One is close behind at $255k market cap.
